role: Test plan referenced by the Emuqu scheme: runs EmuquTests in parallel and EmuquUITests serially, in random order, with coverage on the Emuqu target.
toplevel: configurations: one 'Default' with codeCoverage targets [Emuqu]. defaultOptions.testExecutionOrdering = random (applies to both targets). testTargets: EmuquTests parallelizable true; EmuquUITests parallelizable false. Two _comment strings say why: UI tests run serially because parallel simulator clones made them flaky, and random ordering stays hermetic for UI tests because every launching suite passes -UITests-FreshInstall, under which AppLaunchRecovery.removeStoredSessionData() wipes the stored archive before the app reads it (verified: Emuqu/Sources/Services/AppLaunchRecovery.swift; the UI test files reference -UITests-FreshInstall). Random ordering makes order-dependent unit tests fail non-deterministically rather than consistently. The top-level _comment also says scripts/run_tests_with_coverage.sh (`make test-coverage`, CI) passes -parallel-testing-enabled NO unless PARALLEL_TESTING says otherwise, overriding the parallel settings here.
